translation: Just because you're famous doesn't mean you're important.
wm: just because, even if
〜からと言って、〜わけじゃない = just because X doesn't mean Y.
sb: 有名だからと言って、：just because you're famous
偉いわけじゃない。：doesn't mean you're important
Whole: just because you're famous doesn't mean you're important.
se: Just because you're famous doesn't mean you're important.
Being famous doesn't make you important.
Fame doesn't make you better than anyone.

sentence: 文句じゃないけど、ちょっと遅いわ。
video_line: …もっと丸くなろうじゃないけど言…
video_front: もっと丸くなろうじゃないけど…
video_en: Not that I'd become softer, exactly...
translation: Not to complain, but you're a bit late.
wm: not that..., I'm not saying..., but
Softens what comes next. Hikaru: 丸くなろうじゃないけど.
sb: 文句じゃないけど、：not to complain, but
ちょっと遅いわ。：you're a bit late
Whole: not to complain, but you're a bit late.
se: Not to complain, but you're a bit late.
I'm not complaining, but you're kinda late.
Not to nag, but you're late.

sentence: ある程度は分かるよ。
video_line: …きてま、ある程度まで来たとは思ってるんですけど…
video_front: ある程度まで来たとは思ってるんですけど。
video_en: I think I've come a certain way, but...
translation: I understand it to some extent.
wm: to some extent, to a certain degree
Very common hedge.
sb: ある程度は：to some extent
分かるよ。：I understand
Whole: I understand it to some extent.
se: I understand it to some extent.
I get it, up to a point.
I kind of understand.

sentence: みんなの前で肩身が狭い思いをした。
video_line: …と世間のイメージが悪くなったらファン自体が肩見せない思いするし実際、…
video_front: ファン自体が肩身の狭い思いするし。
video_en: And my fans themselves feel embarrassed.
translation: I felt embarrassed in front of everyone.
wm: to feel ashamed, to feel small (in front of others)
肩身の狭い思いをする = to feel embarrassed. Hikaru: his fans feel this when he's in the news.
sb: みんなの前で：in front of everyone
肩身が狭い思いをした。：felt embarrassed
Whole: I felt embarrassed in front of everyone.
se: I felt embarrassed in front of everyone.
I felt so small in front of everyone.
I was embarrassed in front of the group.
